Termination agreement 
 This Termination Agreement (the “ Agreement ”) is entered into on this day of 25 th of January , 202 1 (the “ Signing Date ”) by and between: 
 
 ZUI Investments having its registered office at Pearl One 94-B/1, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore through its duly authorized representative Fahad Arif Khawaja (hereinafter referred to as “ Employer ”) 
 And 
 Deepwell  Corporation (Private) Limited , a company duly incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan and having its registered office at Suit No. 11, First Floor, Al-Amin Plaza, Mall Road, Saddar, Rawalpindi through its authorized representatives (1) Asfandiyar Riaz holder of CNIC No. 37405-1613727-7 and (2) Shehryar Riaz holder of CNIC No. [ ● ] (hereinafter referred to as “ Contractor ”). 
 (Hereinafter individually also referred to as “ Party ” and collectively as “ Parties ). 
 Whereas 
 A . T he Parties entered into a piling works contract dated 21 st day of August, 20 20 (the “ Contract ”) for the piling and shoring system works of a mixed - use building located at Plot No. 15-A, Sector J , Phase II, Defence Housing Society, Islamabad named and styled as “ Zameen Ace Mall ” (the “ Project ”) ; an d 
 B. Pursuant to Clause 71 of the Contract, the Employer issued a notice of termination dated 14 th December, 2020 (the “ Termination Notice ”) , to the Contractor , wherein the Contract was terminated effective from . Consequently, the Contract stands terminated as of 4 th January , 202 1 , in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Contract and this Termination Agreement. 
 NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, and intending to be legally bound, the Parties hereby agree as follows : 
 Interpretation 
 In this Termination Agreement words and expressions shall have the same meanings as are respectively assigned to them in the Contract , unless otherwise specified. 
 
 Termination 
 
 The effective date of this Termination Agreement and the date of termination of Contract shall be 4 th January , 202 1 (the “ Termination Effective Date ”). 
 
 Pursuant to this Termination Agreement and the Termin ation Notice, As of the Termination Date, the Contract shall no be of no further force and effect from the Effective Date . Notwithstanding any provision of the Contract to the contrary, neither P arty shall have any further obligations thereunder or with respect thereto, except as specifically set forth herein. 
 
 Effect of Termination 
 
 Effective as of the Termination Date, neither Party, their a ffiliates , directors, officers, employees, agents or other representatives shall have any rights, interests, liability or obligation to the other Party u nder the Contract , except t o the extent contemplated under the Contract, including inter alia with respect to indemnity, latent defects, intellectual property rights and confidentiality hat the provisions of, and any liability or obligation contemplated under C lauses 48.2 ( Latent Defects ), 74.1 ( Technical Information Rights , 74.2 ( Equipment Patents ), and 75.1 ( Confidentiality ) of the Contract which shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms of the Contract . 
 
 Payment upon Termination 
 
 The Employer shall , within [ ● ] days of the Termination Effective Date, shall pay the Employer Contractor a sum of R s. upees 2,500,000 (Rupees Two Million Five Hundred Thousand) as full and final settlement of any and all payments due and payable to the Contractor under the Contract ( the “ Final Settlement Amount Payment ”). 
 
 The Parties agree and acknowledge that the Final Settlement A mount Payment has been calculated as the full and final sum due and payable to the Contractor with respect to of ( i ) all Works executed by the Contractor up to (and including) prior to the Termination Effective Date at the rates and prices provided in the Contract , (ii) cost of material, plant and goods ordered for the Works and accepted by the Employer up to the Termination Date, (iii) any and all deductions, adjustment of advances paid, Retention Money, (iv) any and all expenses incurred by the Contractor on behalf of the Employer for the execution of Works under the Contract , and ( i v) any additional sums the Engineer deemed reasonable. The calculation of Final Payment Settlement Amount is set forth in Schedule A of this Agreement. 
 
 Releases 
 
 Upon signing of this Agreement and receipt of the Final Payment , the Contractor shall fully, unconditionally and irrevocably release, waive and discharge the Employer, its affiliates, agents, employees, executives, directors from any and all present or future claims, suits, demands, fees, charges, obligations, liabilities, cause(s) of action (whether in law equity or otherwise), whensoever and howsoever arising and occurring at any time up to (and including) the Effective Date and through the Termination Date , whether known or unknown, direct or indirect, that arise out of or relate to the Contract, including further with respect payment obligations of any kind in connection therewith. 
 
 Obligations of the Contractor 
 
 The Contractor shall by the Termination Dat e remove all Temporary Works, labour , Contractor’s Equipment and machinery from the Site along with any surplus material which was rejected or the delivery of which was not accepted by the Employer prior to the Termination Date. 
 
 The Contractor shall clear the Site of any rubbish, debris, dust and dirt and waste materials and unnecessary obstructions and leave the Site on Termination Date tidy and clean to the satisfaction of the Employer. 
 
 The Contractor shall complete all works mentioned in Clauses 6 .1 and 6 .2 above at his own cost and expense. 
 
 General 
 
 The existence and the terms and conditions of this Agreement and any oral or written information disclosed by the Company Employer in connection with the preparation and/or performance of this Agreement and the Contract shall be regarded as confidential information by the Contractor and the Contractor shall not disclose any such confidential information to any third parties except where such disclosure is required by law. This clause shall remain in force and effect for a period of five (5) years from the Termination Date. 
 
 The Parties hereto agree that if an ambiguity or question of intent arises with respect to any provision of this Agreement, this Agreement shall be construed as if drafted jointly by the Parties and no presumption or burden of proof will arise favoring or disfavoring either Party by virtue of authorship of any of the provisions of this Agreement. 
 
 In the event of any conflict between the Contract and the Termination Agreement , the provisions of th e Contract is Termination Agreement shall prevail except to the extent of the calculation of the Final Payment in this Agreement . 
 
 This Agreement is executed pursuant to, and shall be construed under and governed exclusively by, the substantive and procedural laws of Pakistan . 
 
 The provisions of the Agreement are severable and if one or more provisions are found to be illegal or unenforceable, in whole or part, the remaining provisions, to the extent enforceable, shall be binding and enforceable. 
 
 This Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and same instrument. 
 
 In Witness Whereof , the Parties hereto have caused this Termination Agreement to be executed on the day and year first before written, having fully understood the conditions set herein, in presence of witnesses.
